actions.investigated_summary: The device contains a scripted, persona-based investment-fraud kit: 话术/开场白.txt impersonates a 金玉财经首席分析师助理 pitching a 新能源概念基金 with 历史年化收益超过30% and 老师每天盘中实时带单, funneling victims to 添加老师微信/新手体验金888元 (E7); 话术/应对拒绝.txt supplies canned rebuttals for 考虑一下 and 质疑资质, characteristic of a pre-scripted playbook (E6). data/客户清单.csv (E5) lists three named prospects (王芳 13812345678 50000 已入金; 李强 13987654321 120000 追单中; 赵敏 13666688888 8000 观望) and data/入金记录.txt (E4) records dated USDT transfers (2022-06-19 王芳 50000元 卡号6222020200112233445 张某某; 2022-06-21 李强 120000元 钱包0xFAKE1234567890ABCDEF), forming a 拉新→入金→追单 pipeline. result_semantic_payload.summary: The Windows scope contains a small but internally coherent corpus of 5 files that, taken together, is strong evidence of a scripted, persona-based investment-fraud ("杀猪盘"/"带单" 话术) operation, plus supporting victim/ledger data and an internal-admin pointer. What the evidence establishes: (1) 话术/开场白.txt is a verbatim cold-open sales script in which the caller claims to be "金玉财经的首席分析师助理", pitches a 新能源概念基金 with "历史年化收益超过30%", advertises a "老师每天盘中实时带单", and funnels the target to "添加老师微信,领取新手体验金888元" — classic persona impersonation (fake analyst assistant + fake "老师"/mentor) combined with a fake incentive. (2) 话术/应对拒绝.txt contains two canned rebuttals keyed to specific objections ("考虑一下" → 虚假盈利12%+稀缺话术; "质疑资质" → "境外监管/出入金秒到账/小额试水"), which is the signature of a pre-scripted, objection-handling playbook rather than ad-hoc conversation. (3) The two scripts together form a complete "包装" (packaging) kit: persona + lure + objection handling. (4) data/客户清单.csv and data/入金记录.txt operationalize the playbook into a victim pipeline: three named victims (王芳/李强/赵敏) with phone numbers, investment amounts (50000/120000/8000) and funnel states (已入金/追单中/观望), plus dated USDT transfers (2022-06-19 王芳 50000元 卡号6222020200112233445 张某某; 2022-06-21 李强 120000元 钱包0xFAKE1234567890ABCDEF) — showing a "拉新→入金→追单" progression and USDT-based money movement. (5) README.md declares "内部资料,严禁外传", names the platform "金玉满堂" and gives an admin backend 172.16.8.66:9090, indicating an internal-operational document set rather than a public marketing site. Note the naming inconsistency: README says platform is 金玉满堂 while 开场白.txt pitches 金玉财经 — either two brand variants of one operation or two related operations sharing materials; this cannot be resolved from the evidence. What CANNOT be concluded: (a) no Windows forensic corroboration exists in this scope — no user accounts, logon events, prefetch/AmCache/shim-cache execution traces, registry persistence, event logs, browser/network artifacts, or IM/WeChat logs are present, so the operator's identity, machine ownership, login history and any actual software used to run the operation cannot be established; (b) the file timestamps (mtime/ctime all equal 1789924915) and the two timeline clusters (MODIFIED at 1789924915, CREATED at 1789924922, 7 s apart, covering all 5 files) are consistent with a single bulk staging/copy operation, NOT with organic long-term use — so the timestamps do not support an operational timeline and cannot be used to attribute authorship or duration; the in-document dates (2022-06-19, 2022-06-21) are content, not filesystem evidence; (c) md5 is empty for every file, so content integrity is not independently verified; (d) the wallet address 0xFAKE1234567890ABCDEF is a placeholder string, so no real blockchain transaction is confirmed from this evidence alone; (e) the phone numbers, bank card and personal names are personal data but no independent confirmation that they belong to real victims is present; (f) no evidence in this scope shows the scripts were actually used against any specific target, so "operation existed" is supported but "this device's operator personally executed calls" is not; (g) because only 5 files exist and there is no directory-level or filesystem-journal evidence, we cannot rule out that this is a curated/extracted subset rather than the full working directory. Overall assessment: strong documentary evidence of a scripted persona-based fraud kit and associated victim/ledger data; weak-to-absent evidence tying it to a specific Windows user, machine, or execution history.
